summary: Node/PostgreSQL admission, opaque relay, outbox handoff and BullMQ checkpoint workers; injected generation execution adapter, wired for Timeline renders through render-server when RENDER_SERVER_URL is set.

key_files.src/app.ts: Bearer-token admission plus optional Better Auth browser sessions, owned Project listing and session-only token management. Mounts the shared voice-input routes; session writes enforce the configured public origin.
key_files.src/postgres.ts: pg pool lifecycle and pinned transaction adapter. Rollback on failure, release in finally, destroy on rollback failure.
key_files.src/migrations.ts: Explicit versioned migration runner (runMigrations): one transaction, advisory lock first, optional lock_timeout, checksum guard, plan mode, expand/contract classification and gate (contract refused on a live database without allowContract; bootstrap applies all), ahead ids for rollback. migrateDatabase applies everything (tests). App startup never auto-migrates. Includes 0016_gateway.sql (#362).
key_files.src/migrate.ts: The one migrate path (decision 12): runMigrations then BullMQ queue schema; a plan touches neither.
key_files.src/gateway-cli.ts: #377 operator CLI: `gateway migrate [--plan] [--allow-contract] [--lock-timeout-ms]` and `gateway seed` (pnpm gateway / migrate / seed:gateway). JSON report on stdout; `CODE: message` on stderr; driver failures print class + SQLSTATE only. Runbook: apps/docs/guide/gateway-node-rollout.md.
key_files.src/gateway-migrate.test.ts: PGlite: plan writes nothing, one-shot idempotence, lock-first single transaction, lock-timeout mapping, contract gate atomicity, bootstrap/marker, ahead on rollback, checksum code, classifier cases.
key_files.src/integration/gateway-migrate.lite.tes: Lite harness (real PG): 4 racing gateway migrate processes apply once, MIGRATION_LOCK_TIMEOUT while another session holds the lock, seed refused before migrate and Flash-only after.
key_files.src/server.ts: HTTP listeners and bounded graceful shutdown. GATEWAY_ROLE (#373) selects data plane (api|all), admin console listener (admin|all), or refuses migrate (entrypoint one-shot). Requires DATABASE_URL and CLOUD_PUBLIC_URL; HOST defaults to loopback. Wires #371 admin API and #372 /admin console.
key_files.src/app.test.ts: Real HTTP listener with PGlite SQL, database token lookup, forged identity rejection, owner isolation and token revocation. Not a network PostgreSQL test.
key_files.src/replica-log.ts: Project-scoped opaque binary log + atomic outbox, content-checked idempotent append, lease claims with SKIP LOCKED and fenced acknowledgement. Caller owns authorization; clients/checkpoint worker own Loro validation. pg_notify carries only project/cursor.
key_files.src/outbox-worker.ts: Notification delivery and fenced checkpoint handoff to BullMQ; starts snapshot consumers and sweeps abandoned Project Asset import staging from CLOUD_ASSET_DIR every 10 minutes. Always runs api-node:gateway-settle runs (#399) through routeRunCoordinators; with RENDER_SERVER_URL it also routes Timeline render runs (api-node:generation) on the same BullMQ queue; no other generation product ports are configured by this CLI.
key_files.src/checkpoint.ts: Paged immutable-prefix reconstruction using shared LoroStateAdapter, pending-dependency check and monotonic binary checkpoint publication; never truncate event history here.
key_files.src/pg-notifications.ts: One dedicated PG LISTEN connection per process, reconnect plus durable reconciliation; notifications are wake-ups only.
key_files.deploy/compose.yaml: #374+#373 self-host topology, PostgreSQL multi-node only: postgres, one-shot GATEWAY_ROLE=migrate gate, api-1..3 (GATEWAY_ROLE=api), outbox worker command (not a GATEWAY_ROLE), admin (GATEWAY_ROLE=admin + GATEWAY_ADMIN_PORT), optional all under profiles:[demo], mock-upstream under profiles:[test]. Role matrix api|admin|all|migrate only; no gateway worker role, no SQLite/minimal, no Redis, no LB (anti-pattern 4). read_only rootfs + tini/init.
key_files.deploy/Dockerfile: #373 multi-stage image: pnpm deploy --prod, deliberate tsx ship (no api-node dist yet), non-root node, tini ENTRYPOINT + deploy/entrypoint.sh GATEWAY_ROLE switch (api|admin|all|migrate), HEALTHCHECK /healthz, node:24-slim digest pin, no secrets in layers. Placeholder GATEWAY_ADMIN_WEB_DIR for admin|all.
key_files.src/deploy-compose.test.ts: Parses deploy/compose.yaml + Dockerfile/entrypoint against package scripts, gatewayRole matrix (#373), admin listener wiring, read_only/tini/digest/healthz, databaseUrl/publicUrl and drain timings; also no LB config in deploy/.
key_files.scripts/test-cluster.ts: Opt-in native Node runner for disposable loopback PostgreSQL plus independent gateway/worker processes; test:cluster. Never deploys or registers a service.
key_files.src/integration/cluster.integration.test: Real TCP PG fault and load acceptance; unique database and child-process cleanup. Separate Vitest config; not default unit suite.
key_files.src/relay-http.ts: Authenticated @loro-dev/streams-client profile: append/catch-up JSON records, binary snapshots and live SSE data. No Loro state; ACK means durable bytes. Not a complete stream provisioning or producer-epoch API.
key_files.src/relay-store.ts: PG snapshot and captured-prefix paged log adapter; retained event IDs provide append idempotency.
key_files.src/checkpoint-store.ts: Database-only checkpoint load/save, separate from Loro worker computation.
key_files.src/relay-http.test.ts: SDK, snapshot/tail, local persistence failure, opaque bytes and Local Host discovery integration.
key_files.src/checkpoint-outbox.test.ts: Delayed coalescing, concurrent tail preservation, lease fencing, failure retention and atomic append/intent rollback.
key_files.src/task-runtime.ts: BullMQ PostgreSQL Flow driver for an injected shared Durable Run coordinator (routeRunCoordinators serves several owners on one journal by each run's journaled owner), plus durable checkpoint jobs. Stable dispatch IDs; bounded retries; retained jobs; worker-thread computation.
key_files.src/durable-run-journal.ts: PostgreSQL journal using shared frozen-record validation and CAS; initial run and dispatch intent commit atomically.
key_files.src/checkpoint-thread.ts: Isolated Loro checkpoint computation with its own PG connection; leaves queue heartbeat responsive.
key_files.src/durable-run.test.ts: Real PGlite transaction rollback, idempotency, frozen input and stale CAS verification.
Real PG multi-worker Flow, duplicate dispatch, delayed polling, failure projection, transient snapshot failure and SIGKILL generation recovery.
key_files.src/integration/generation-worker-proces: Test-only child process with durable fixture effects; supports killing after staging side effect.
key_files.src/auth.ts: Better Auth PostgreSQL email/password/session and database rate limiting; explicitly migrated auth tables; public origin is the only trusted origin.
key_files.src/generation.ts: Node binding of shared hosted generation admission and lifecycle to PG journal plus atomic dispatch intent. Product provider/storage/publication ports remain injected.
key_files.src/integration/auth.integration.test.ts: Actual HTTP server and real PG: signup/signin, hashed token issuance, cross-origin and cross-account rejection, revocation, signout, and token-backed admission.
key_files.src/personal-assets.ts: Authenticated personal Asset library: shared Resource/GlobalAssetEntry/ResolvedAsset schemas, PG ownership and transactional lifecycle CAS, immutable filesystem media with Range delivery. CLOUD_ASSET_DIR requires a persistent shared volume for multiple API instances.
key_files.src/personal-assets.test.ts: PGlite HTTP contract coverage for user isolation, import idempotency, invalid uploads, ranges, deletion/restore retries and lost media.
key_files.src/integration/personal-assets.integrat: Real PostgreSQL and HTTP: cookie/origin enforcement, upload and read across Node restart, concurrent deletion CAS.
key_files.src/projects.ts: Owner-scoped browser Project management. Creation uses the existing admission store; detail selects Streams sync.
key_files.src/project-document.ts: Transactional owner-scoped Project Loro reads and mutations: locked relay head, checkpoint and contiguous log hydration, atomic relay/outbox append.
key_files.src/project-document.test.ts: PGlite behavior coverage for owner isolation, browser update hydration, persisted mutation and rollback.
key_files.src/timeline-host.ts: Authenticated Timeline Host commands over the durable Project log: list/create/apply/attach/detach/delete, account/project-scoped read receipts and serialized CAS. A Hono shell over shared cloud-project-host/timeline-commands; appends only when the command reports a mutation. With render configured it binds the same {actorUserId} timelineRender port as Cloudflare and admits the run inside the command transaction; otherwise request_timeline_render answers 501, as do other command families.
key_files.src/timeline-render.ts: Timeline render over the shared hosted generation pipeline (video_render). Admission claims the render node (generating + pendingTask) and journals run timeline-render:<nodeId> in the host-command transaction, so a synced local Host never renders it too. The worker resolves media through the shared resolveTimelineMediaReferences (an unavailable clip fails the run reference_unavailable before rendering; errorCode is projected onto the node), calls the RenderServerPort, stores bytes and publishes Asset (id = run) + completed node in one transaction; republishing is a no-op. Failure marks only a node this run still claims. A retried host-command still creates a second node (#218).
key_files.src/timeline-render.test.ts: PGlite: in-transaction claim and journal, one render and one publication across rerun, a second worker and publish redelivery (fake RenderServerPort); failure projection; an Asset trashed after admission fails reference_unavailable on the node without rendering; unconfigured 501; signed media valid, expired, tampered and foreign-domain cases.
key_files.src/project-media-url.ts: Signed, 1-hour, domain-separated (clash-node-media-v1:) URLs for one Project Asset under CLOUD_PUBLIC_URL/assets/project-media, keyed by BETTER_AUTH_SECRET through shared signed-capability. Serves only that active Asset's bytes (Range supported); mounted outside /api, and only when render is configured. nodeProjectAssetReferences is the api-node binding of the shared ProjectAssetReferenceResolver (Project document + project_resource rows + this signing).
key_files.src/config.ts: DATABASE_URL, CLOUD_PUBLIC_URL and PORT validation. Optional RENDER_SERVER_URL accepts only an http(s) origin and requires BETTER_AUTH_SECRET. Reads ACTION_SECRET_KEY for provider credential envelopes.
key_files.src/timeline-definition.ts: Loads the bundled Remotion Timeline projection contract through the shared cloud plugin catalog (same schema hash as the local plugin host). Node renders through render-server (timeline-render.ts), never the Remotion executor.
key_files.src/project-assets.ts: Project Asset SDK HTTP adapter: Loro-backed list/batch/read/references/import, signed account/project observations, and authenticated media ranges. Postgres Resource rows and disk bytes are ports of shared cloud-project-host/project-assets; Resource admission commits with Project log updates.
key_files.src/media-store.ts: Shared personal/project immutable media publication, MIME validation and byte-range delivery; content-addressed files require a persistent shared volume.
key_files.src/integration/project-assets.integrati: Real PostgreSQL contract coverage for Project upload retries, immutable identity conflicts, Loro persistence, SDK read receipts, byte ranges and owner isolation.
key_files.src/telemetry.ts: OpenTelemetry bootstrap for the server, loaded with --import before app code; standard OTEL_* environment, off until an OTLP endpoint is set (OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT or a signal-specific one); OTEL_SDK_DISABLED=true off regardless.
key_files.src/telemetry-outbox.ts: Same bootstrap for the outbox worker process (default service.name clash-api-node-outbox).
key_files.src/log.ts: Structured JSON-line logger (shared-telemetry) and errorFacts: logs error class/code only, never messages that may contain connection strings.
key_files.src/metrics.ts: Business metrics on the OTel Metrics API: generation terminal duration, outbox dispatch outcomes, outbox backlog gauge. Bounded enum attributes only.
key_files.src/project-host.contract.test.ts: Shared Project Host contract on PGlite + temporary disk; declares catalog and asset trash/restore as known gaps.
key_files.src/provider-settings.ts: PostgreSQL read models for provider accounts, model-card configs and usage audit; credentials are decrypted only through the shared secret envelope. Mirrors the D1 tables without foreign keys.
key_files.src/voice-input.ts: Node wiring for the shared voice-input route factory and hosted ports; catalog/credentials/audit come from Postgres, no Provider transcription logic lives here.
key_files.src/gateway-seed.ts: Explicit Flash-only gateway seed (#362/#377): deepseek-v4-flash catalog + credits price rows; refuses non-Flash DeepSeek model codes, upstreams and card implementations. Never migrates (GATEWAY_SEED_SCHEMA_PENDING); `gateway seed`; never on startup.
key_files.src/gateway-schema.test.ts: PGlite: 0016 applies; ledger charge-once (request_id, budget_id, kind); credential '' uniqueness; seed Flash-only refuse; settle intent PK.
key_files.src/mock-upstream/: Test-only deterministic mock upstream (NODES §4.4 / #378): OpenAI + Anthropic JSON/SSE with latency/failure control API, key-hash stats, fake sk_test_* keys only. CLI: pnpm mock-upstream / scripts/mock-upstream.ts. Never for production.
key_files.src/gateway-keyring.ts: Envelope v2 key ring (#366): v2.<kid>.<iv>.<ct> AES-256-GCM, HKDF per (kid, scope), AAD binds scope/tenant/credential id; opens v1 shared-runtime envelopes (official only); derived-key cache; refuses keys shared with ACTION_SECRET_KEY.
key_files.src/gateway-credentials.ts: PG upstream credential store/port (#366) over gateway_upstream_credential: official vs tenant never mix; current kid from gateway_config encryption.current per request (multi-node propagation); lazy CAS reseal of v1/old-kid envelopes; batch reencrypt.
key_files.src/gateway-key-admin.ts: Audited admin rotation routes (#366) /api/v1/admin/gateway/encryption{,/rotate,/reencrypt}; injected admin verifier (#394); encryption.read / encryption.rotate (gateway-admin-authz.ts); audit row in same tx; no key material in responses.
key_files.src/gateway-admin.ts: #371/#372 admin API on its own listener (GATEWAY_ADMIN_PORT/HOST/ORIGINS): teams, users, budgets, keys, usage, overview, audit, catalog, upstream routes, abuse, admin tokens + billing and key-ring route sets; CSRF origin check; public listener 404s /api/v1/admin/* (createGatewayHttpServers); prompt view always GATEWAY_PROMPT_ACCESS_DISABLED. On GATEWAY_ROLE=admin also serves the shared apps/web /admin console + /api/admin-auth.
key_files.src/gateway-admin-authz.ts: #371 permission table for the single platform_admin role (hosted permission names + encryption.read/rotate); no tenant_admin/viewer matrix.
key_files.src/gateway-admin-tokens.ts: #371 gwa_ admin tokens over gateway_admin_token (SHA-256 only, Authorization header only, never product users); audited issue/revoke, last platform_admin kept; pnpm admin-token bootstrap CLI.
key_files.src/gateway-admin.test.ts: PGlite + real sockets: public port 404 for admin paths (every spelling), single platform_admin role, CSRF, no secret in any response or audit row, every endpoint group audited, self-host prompt refusal and no body columns.
key_files.src/gateway-admin-console.ts: #372 shared apps/web console static serving on the admin listener when GATEWAY_ROLE=admin|all (GATEWAY_ADMIN_WEB_DIR); mounts /admin*, /_app/* and top-level build assets onto createGatewayAdminApp. API-only admin listeners (GATEWAY_ADMIN_PORT without admin/all role) stay API-only (#371).
key_files.src/gateway-admin-reads.ts: #372 console overview read model over Postgres (N2 ledger shapes) used by GET /overview on the admin API.
key_files.src/admin-auth.ts: #372 admin Better Auth (/api/admin-auth, clash-admin cookies) over 0022 admin_* tables for the shared console sign-in, alongside gwa_ tokens; never auth_*; createNodeAdminAccount bootstrap.
key_files.src/admin-account-cli.ts: pnpm admin-account:create: first admin account from ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_NAME/ADMIN_PASSWORD (env only); never migrates.
key_files.src/gateway-admin-console.test.ts: PGlite: console assets served only when mounted; admin API role gating; overview/budget/usage/encryption/abuse views.
key_files.src/admin-auth.test.ts: PGlite (pg Pool shim): bootstrap audited, clash-admin sign-in and session verify, no sign-up, disabled account refused, no auth_* rows.
key_files.src/gateway-keyring.test.ts: PGlite: v2/v1 envelopes, scope isolation, lazy reseal, two-node rotation propagation, audit append-only, no plaintext.
key_files.src/gateway-node.ts: #367: gateway-core createGatewayApp over Postgres ports (sk_gw_ virtual key / clsh_ / session identity, routes, budgets from gateway-budget-port.ts, settlement from gateway-settle.ts, ledger read of charges and debits with their refunds).
